name: as_ref_unchecked
rules: For safety, self must be convertible to a shared reference to T.

For safety, as_ref_unchecked must not be used if self may be null; as_ref must be used instead when the value is known to be initialized, and as_uninit_ref must be used instead when the value may be uninitialized.
For safety, as_ref_unchecked must not be used if the value behind self may be uninitialized; as_uninit_ref must be used instead.
